c74object.name: syncSuite.video.source
c74object.digest: Utility for rendering textures, matrices, playing video files and compositing controls.
c74object.description: It allows intelligent loading and playback of video files, texture processing such as cropping, inserting fx, among others operations. It is designed to work with the syncSuite Max4Live devices for video syncronization with Ableton Live.
